source_question: Ok, I will come to sign in the afternoon
core: Okay, I'll come by this afternoon to sign it.
meaning_cn: 好的，我今天下午过去签一下。
explanation_cn: come by 表示“过来一趟/顺便过来”，比单独用 come 更自然；this afternoon 直接表示“今天下午”。如果是签署文件，用 sign it；sign in 通常表示“签到/登录”，不能代替“签文件”。
source_sentence: Ok, I will come to sign in the afternoon

examples.en: Okay, I'll come by this afternoon to sign it.
examples.cn: 好的，我今天下午过去签一下。

examples.en: I'll come by after 3 p.m. to sign the form.
examples.cn: 我下午三点后过去签表格。

examples.en: Can I come by tomorrow morning to sign the document?
examples.cn: 我明天上午可以过去签文件吗？

pronunciation.text: Okay, I'll come by this afternoon to sign it.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 come by、this afternoon 和 sign it；I'll come by 连起来说会更自然。

source_question: 对方说 See you later / Thanks Mr. Yang / Have a great day，这种怎么回
core: Thanks, you too. See you later!
explanation_cn: 别人说 Have a great day 时，最自然的简短回应之一是 Thanks, you too.；如果双方稍后还会见面，可以再接 See you later!。这种回复轻松、礼貌，适合熟悉同事之间的日常工作聊天。
source_sentence: See you later dear. Thanks Mr. Yang. Have a great day.

examples.en: Thanks, you too. See you later!
Thanks! Have a great day too.
examples.cn: 谢谢！你也祝你今天愉快。

pronunciation.text: Thanks, you too. See you later!
pronunciation.hint_cn: Thanks 和 you too 语气轻松；See you later 连读自然，不需要逐词重读。
